en.name: Ham salad
en.summary: Ham salad keeps 3–4 days in the refrigerator at 4 °C (40 °F) or below. What sets that limit is the chopped cooked ham and how long the bowl sits warm — not the mayonnaise, which is acidified and made with pasteurised egg.
en.pantry: Ham salad is ready to eat and there is no cooking step left, so it does not get a room-temperature allowance. Chopping or mincing cooked ham multiplies its surface area enormously and handles it by hand at the same time, which is the step that matters; the cured ham it started from is more robust than what you end up with. Give it two hours out of the fridge at most, or one hour above 32 °C (90 °F), and serve from a bowl set over ice at a picnic or a buffet.
en.fridge: 3–4 days at 4 °C (40 °F) or below, covered, on a cold shelf rather than in the door. Mix it from ham that is already cold, and put the container straight back after serving rather than leaving it out through a meal. Do not add a fresh batch to the remains of an old one — that resets nothing and simply extends the life of the oldest ham in the bowl. If you used deli ham with a short opened window, make the salad early in that window, not at the end of it.
en.freezer: No freezer timeline is published for ham salad, and freezing is not worth doing. The mayonnaise emulsion splits irreversibly on thawing, leaving oily liquid around dry, salty ham, and any celery or pickle in the mixture goes limp. If you have ham that needs using up, freeze it as plain pieces or slices and make the salad fresh after thawing.
spoilage: A sour or sharp smell rather than a clean cured-ham one.
Dressing that has split, with watery liquid under it.
A slimy or sticky texture on the ham pieces.
Mould on the surface, or a grey or greenish cast to the meat.
tips: Use ham that is properly cold before mixing.
Serve from a bowl over ice, not from the storage tub.
Never top up an old batch with a fresh one.
Freeze plain ham rather than the finished salad.

faq.q: How long does ham salad keep?
faq.a: 3–4 days in a covered container in the fridge at 4 °C (40 °F) or below.

faq.q: Is the mayonnaise the problem in ham salad?
faq.a: No. Commercial mayonnaise is acidified and uses pasteurised egg. The chopped cooked ham and the time the bowl spends warm are what matter.
No timeline is published and it is not worth doing — the dressing splits. Freeze plain ham and make the salad after thawing.

zh.name: 火腿沙拉
zh.summary: 火腿沙拉冷藏 4 °C 以下可放 3～4 天。決定這個期限的是切碎的熟火腿，以及那碗東西在溫熱狀態下放了多久——不是美乃滋；美乃滋經過酸化、用的是殺菌蛋液。
zh.pantry: 火腿沙拉是即食料理，後面沒有加熱步驟，所以它沒有室溫額度。把熟火腿切碎或絞碎，會讓表面積暴增，同時又免不了被手大量接觸，那才是關鍵的一步；一開始那塊醃製火腿，其實比你手上這碗結果耐放得多。離開冰箱最多兩小時，氣溫超過 32 °C 時最多一小時；野餐或自助餐請把碗架在冰上供應。
zh.fridge: 加蓋放 4 °C 以下 3～4 天，要放冷藏層架而不是門邊。請用已經冰透的火腿來拌，取用後容器立刻冰回去，不要整餐放在外面。也不要把新做的加進舊的剩料裡——那並不會重新計時，只是延長碗裡最舊那塊火腿的壽命。如果用的是開封期限很短的即食火腿片，請在那段期限的前段做沙拉，不要拖到最後。
zh.freezer: 火腿沙拉沒有公布的冷凍期限，也不值得冷凍。美乃滋的乳化在解凍後會不可逆地崩解，留下一圈油水包著又乾又鹹的火腿；裡面的芹菜或酸黃瓜也會全軟掉。火腿吃不完的話，請把原味的整片或整塊冷凍，解凍後再現拌沙拉。
spoilage: 聞起來發酸刺鼻，而不是乾淨的醃火腿味。
醬汁油水分離，底下積水。
火腿塊摸起來黏滑或發黏。
表面長霉，或肉色泛灰、泛綠。
tips: 用確實冰透的火腿來拌。
分到架在冰上的碗裡上桌，不要端保存盒。
絕對不要把新的補進舊的剩料。
要冷凍就冷凍原味火腿，不要冷凍拌好的沙拉。

faq.a: 加蓋容器放 4 °C 以下冷藏 3～4 天。
不是。市售美乃滋經過酸化並使用殺菌蛋液。關鍵是切碎的熟火腿，以及它在溫熱狀態放了多久。
沒有公布的期限，也不值得——醬會分離。請冷凍原味火腿，解凍後再拌。
